# Catalogue

<!-- Generated by `memors-scenario book` from `internal/eval/testdata/scenario-catalogue.yaml`. Do not edit: change the source and run `make scenario-docs`. -->

The scenarios the harness should hold, grouped by what they stress. Each entry is a story: actors, steps over time, and what must be observable. A file implements an entry when its name starts with the entry's id (`b2-zombie-fact.yaml`) or its `covers:` names it. The tier says where the scenario will run: `ci` on every pull request with the hash embedder, `nightly` with a real model, `binary` against the built `memors-mcp` process.

## A. Two clocks and time

Recorded time (when the store learned something) against valid time (when it was true), and what ageing does to ranking.

<a id="a1"></a>

### A1 Expiry during the run

Fact with `valid_to` day 10; query at day 5 and 15; `lint` at 15 reports `expired-fact`; search behaviour per gap 8.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [8](gaps.md#gap-8)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="a2"></a>

### A2 Out-of-order arrival

Day 20 an agent records F2; day 25 a human records F1 with `valid_from` day 1. `as_of` day 22 returns F2 (recorded time); `facts --as-of`, `history` and the conflict detector agree with each other.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="a3"></a>

### A3 Backdated supersession chain

F1 (valid Jan) → F2 (valid Mar) supersedes → F3 (valid Feb, late evidence) supersedes F2; `history` shows both clocks without contradiction.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="a4"></a>

### A4 Re-confirmed note never refreshes

The same note re-ingested unchanged at day 0/100/200 is a dedup no-op each time, so recency keeps ageing it. Decide whether re-ingest bumps freshness.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="a5"></a>

### A5 Revision churn

One document revised 30 times with a page on it; `built_from_rev` monotonic, one open stale item at a time, `as_of` per day returns that day's revision, the final page cites live chunks.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="a6"></a>

### A6 Recency across the horizon

Identical notes at ages 0/30/365/730 plus one `curated` document; documents do not age, notes newest first; a one-second clock move must not flip ties.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

## B. Human confirm / reject loops

A human confirms, corrects or rejects what agents wrote, through the CLI or an elicitation dialog.

<a id="b1"></a>

### B1 Decline then retry

Declined: nothing changes, the CLI command comes back, no audit row. Accepted: audited on the elicitation channel.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** implemented by [b1-promote-decline-then-accept](log/b1-promote-decline-then-accept.md)

<a id="b2"></a>

### B2 Zombie fact

A human forgets an agent fact with a reason; the agent records the same statement again and nothing links the two.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [15](gaps.md#gap-15)
- **Status:** implemented by [b2-zombie-fact](log/b2-zombie-fact.md)

<a id="b3"></a>

### B3 Human corrects, agent holds the old id

The human supersedes a curated fact from the CLI; the agent later calls `remember` with `supersedes` on the old id and gets "already superseded"; its fact must land as a conflict item against the human's, not vanish.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="b4"></a>

### B4 Demote

A curated document demoted to `agent`; `scope.min_trust: user` excludes it; facts citing it keep their own trust; pages built from it are unchanged.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="b5"></a>

### B5 Partial review

Of 6 items the human resolves 2, skips 2, ignores 2; the next `compact` must not re-propose skipped items without two new passages.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [11](gaps.md#gap-11)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="b6"></a>

### B6 Promote, then an agent revises

A human promotes a source to `curated`; an agent then re-ingests a changed copy through the tool channel.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [1](gaps.md#gap-1)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="b7"></a>

### B7 Merge stickiness

The human rejects merge A~B; agents keep writing both spellings; the resolver must not re-open the pair (verified sticky; keep as a regression); after an accept, new ingests of B resolve to A and `explore` shows the alias.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="b8"></a>

### B8 Elicitation on HTTP with several clients

Several clients on one `serve --http` server; one answers a promote dialog meant for another.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [7](gaps.md#gap-7)
- **Status:** planned

## C. Many agents writing notes

Several agents write into shared namespaces, agree in different words, disagree, or write at once.

<a id="c1"></a>

### C1 Same claim, different words

Three agents remember paraphrases with the same `about`; today one conflict item per pair; all three vote for one evidence passage.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [10](gaps.md#gap-10)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c2"></a>

### C2 Disagreement without a human

Two agents' facts conflict; lint reports it; a third agent resolves it through `compact` and `submit`; the loser is history, raw rows unchanged.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** implemented by [c2-two-agents-disagree](log/c2-two-agents-disagree.md)

<a id="c3"></a>

### C3 Spoofed actor

Two sessions named `claude-code` on `serve --http`.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [6](gaps.md#gap-6)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c4"></a>

### C4 Stale re-ingest

An agent re-ingests an older cached copy of a document that has moved on.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [5](gaps.md#gap-5)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c5"></a>

### C5 Drowning by chatter

500 agent notes of generic standup text from 5 agents plus 5 curated documents; curated answers keep recall@5; abstention queries still abstain (real model).

- **Tier:** nightly
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c6"></a>

### C6 Namespace spill

One agent writes to `personal`; another searches unscoped; measure the contamination rate so a future change is comparable.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c7"></a>

### C7 Submit after concurrent ingest

A page is submitted after passages it should cite were added or revised since `compact`.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [4](gaps.md#gap-4)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c8"></a>

### C8 Two agents, one work item

Both compact, both submit; the second gets "already done"; the first page is not overwritten; one `submit` audit row.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c9"></a>

### C9 Concurrent same-URI ingest over HTTP

Exactly one live revision per source, contiguous revision numbers, both audit rows.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="c10"></a>

### C10 Spelling variants over time

Four spellings of one name from four agents; merge precision stays at or above 0.95 as the stream grows; after human merges, `explore` from any spelling reaches one neighbourhood.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

## D. Adversarial, in a living system

Poisoned or hostile content arriving through the normal channels, and whether trust and revocation hold.

<a id="d1"></a>

### D1 Poison amplification loop

A web page with a fact-shaped sentence about a trusted entity; an agent remembers it citing that chunk; chunk and fact now vote together. The curated answer's rank must not drop a band.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="d2"></a>

### D2 Revoked but still reachable

Forget the poisoned document; the claim must be unreachable via search at every granularity, `explore`, the page and the citing fact.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [2](gaps.md#gap-2), [3](gaps.md#gap-3)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="d3"></a>

### D3 Graph hijack via declared entities

Junk ingested with a declared entity name; multi-hop queries about that entity must not surface it above the real pages.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="d4"></a>

### D4 Homoglyph identifiers

An identifier with a Cyrillic letter; the exact arm and the merge resolver must not silently merge it with the ASCII one.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="d5"></a>

### D5 Instruction text in reasons and titles

A tool-channel forget plants instruction-shaped text in a tombstone reason or a title.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [9](gaps.md#gap-9)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="d6"></a>

### D6 Tool-channel privilege probe

A scripted agent tries every mutation on `user` and `curated` records across all ten tools, including revise; every attempt fails with `needs_human` and leaves no audit row.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

## E. Operational lifecycle

Crashes, reindexing, migrations, backups and growth while the system is in use.

<a id="e1"></a>

### E1 Crash between commit and vectors

The process is killed between the ingest commit and vector storage.

- **Tier:** binary
- **Gaps:** [13](gaps.md#gap-13)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e2"></a>

### E2 Partial reindex

Switch model, interrupt `reindex` at 50%; queries say which model's vectors ran; `degraded` semantics defined.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e3"></a>

### E3 Migrate a populated file

An older knowledge-base file with real content is migrated by the built binary.

- **Tier:** binary
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e4"></a>

### E4 Backup mid-write

A backup is taken while agents are writing.

- **Tier:** binary
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e5"></a>

### E5 Export/import at mid-life

Export and re-import a knowledge base that holds documents, facts and pages.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [14](gaps.md#gap-14)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e6"></a>

### E6 Index resource under growth

With 10k documents `memo://index` truncates deterministically and prefers live, high-trust, recent entries.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e7"></a>

### E7 Graph cache under continuous ingest

Structural-arm p95 while another agent ingests every second.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e8"></a>

### E8 Graph cache same-count revision

A revision that keeps the live mention count unchanged.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Gaps:** [12](gaps.md#gap-12)
- **Status:** planned

<a id="e9"></a>

### E9 Log prune during use

`log prune` runs while searches and tool calls are being logged.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

## F. Retrieval quality on a drifting corpus

Ranking quality when the ground truth moves with time, and relations that must hold when no label exists.

<a id="f1"></a>

### F1 Time-indexed labels

Ground truth generated from a planted fact timeline; facts with validity windows first, documents and notes generated from them, queries at several days with the relevant set derived from the timeline.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="f2"></a>

### F2 Trust vs freshness boundary

An agent fact (new) against a curated fact (old) inside and just outside the 10% tiebreak; small content perturbations must not flip the order.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="f3"></a>

### F3 Abstention under contamination

Abstention queries keep abstaining as unrelated content accumulates (real model).

- **Tier:** nightly
- **Status:** planned

<a id="f4"></a>

### F4 Non-English notes

Notes and queries in languages other than English (real model).

- **Tier:** nightly
- **Status:** planned

<a id="f5"></a>

### F5 Determinism

The same scenario twice gives identical ranked lists.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned

<a id="f6"></a>

### F6 Metamorphic relations

Adding irrelevant documents must not reorder the existing top-k; scoped results are a subset of unscoped; duplicating a document must not double its score; `exclude_ids` paging is consistent with the unpaged list.

- **Tier:** ci
- **Status:** planned
